description: List Zendesk tickets with pagination and filtering. Only server-side filter available is external_id; status, priority, tags, assignee_id, and date-range filters must be applied client-side. Timestamps (created_at, updated_at) are ISO 8601 UTC. ticket.subject may be null — coerce to string before filtering. Attachments are not included; retrieve via zendesk.get_zendesk_ticket_by_id. HTTP 429 rate limit responses include Retry-After header; apply exponential backoff. Paginate by following next_page until null to avoid missing tickets.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing Zendesk tickets with pagination and filtering.

external_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the external system's ticket ID to show only tickets linked to that identifier.
external_id.title: External Id

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total. For larger datasets, use cursor pagination (page_size) instead.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start at 1 and increase to browse through more tickets. Limited to page 100.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'after_cursor' or 'next' link.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'before_cursor' or 'prev' link.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of tickets per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets instead of page/per_page.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of tickets per page using cursor-based pagination. Recommended for accessing more than 10,000 records.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of tickets per page for offset pagination (max 100). Note: page * per_page cannot exceed 10,000. Set to 100 for large accounts to minimize requests before client-side filtering.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many tickets to show on each page. You can choose up to 100; smaller numbers can make pages load faster.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_by.description: Field to sort by: 'assignee', 'assignee.name', 'created_at', 'group', 'id', 'requester', 'requester.name', 'status', 'subject', 'updated_at' Omitting sort_by provides no guaranteed ordering; set explicitly when ticket order matters.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Pick the ticket field to sort by (e.g., created date, updated date, status, assignee) so results appear in the order you prefer.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose the direction of sorting—ascending (asc) or descending (desc)—to control how the list is ordered.
sort_order.title: Sort Order
